entries.text: The House Committee on Rules reported an original measure, H. Rept. 119-785, by Ms. Foxx.

entries.text: The resolution provides for consideration of H.R. 1501, H.R. 9436, H.Res. 1490, and H.R. 4795 under a closed rule with one hour of general debate on each measure. The resolution provides for a motion to recommit on H.R. 1501, H.R. 9436, and H.R. 4795.
